object.attr: A paused session does not count, so ground covered during a pause adds nothing, and the totals from before the pause stay. Today the first fix after a resume is measured from the stale pre-pause position, which adds that gap to the distance. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: When the session returns to the recording state from the paused state, the app shall start the distance measurement from the first location fix received after the resume, adding 0 m for that location fix.
